title: Ensure docgen dependencies are pinned
body:
**Do you want to request a *feature* or report a *bug*?**

Bug

**Bug: What is the current behavior?**

When coming to the project and doing `yarn dev` you might end up with different deps than other coworkers (even with yarn.lock, explanation: https://github.com/algolia/react-element-to-jsx-string/pull/93#issuecomment-316967321). Thus reducing the reproducibility of the repo.

**Bug: What is the expected behavior?**

Doing `yarn dev` should lead the same result everytime.

**Bug: What is the proposed solution?**

Define dependencies from docgen as devDependencies so renovate take them
